prospective_contrast: At fixed u and h, compare histories that differ only in the oldest or newest drive. The existing matched contrasts show order-sensitive history effects; additional prospective contrasts can test whether either endpoint's effect changes with h.

quantities.interpretation: Oldest prior drive, over the interval ending at -4 s.
quantities.name: oldest_drive

quantities.interpretation: Most recent prior drive, over the interval ending at -1 s.
quantities.name: newest_drive

refutation_condition: Refute this representation if the completed sparse polynomial fails raw-response RMSE <= 0.06 on the supplied dev data, or if independent matched-condition responses show systematic residuals beyond the calibrated 0.015-unit readout bound.
scientific_change: Replace the instantaneous-only response assumption with an order-sensitive history representation using the oldest and newest prior drives. Matched histories with equal means but different order have distinct responses, while the available evidence does not establish that the two intermediate drives are needed.
